$comment: style-spec.json — the single input to the design system. Every generated file derives from this. Fields marked (opt) may be omitted; everything else is required. Remove $comment keys in the real file or leave them; the scripts ignore keys starting with $.
name: Acme
$prefix: Used for CSS vars (--acme-…) and the Swift enum (AcmeTokens). kebab-case, 2–8 chars.
$platforms: One or more of: react-native | web | swiftui. Default when the user doesn't say: ["react-native"] (iOS).
$output: Folder at project root. Default design-system.

color.$seeds: Hex seeds. secondary/accent (opt). The script generates 11-step ramps and snaps the seed into its nearest step so the exact brand hex appears.

status.$status: Override only if the brand has its own status hues. Defaults shown.

type.$families: Font family names as the platform will load them. Use "System" for SF Pro / system-ui.
type.$staticWeights: true if the font ships per-weight files (Inter-SemiBold). Emits per-weight family names for RN/Swift.
type.$density: normal | compact. compact scales component padding by 0.75, not the space primitives.

shape.$border: hairline | regular — the default border weight components use

$elevation: low | medium | high — scales shadow alpha/blur. low ≈ flat/bordered UIs.

components.$include: When tier is custom: Core is always built; list Extended component names to add, e.g. ["SearchField","Slider","Banner"]
components.$exclude: Rare. Core components to skip, with a reason in notes.

accessibility.$target: AA | AAA. Drives the contrast threshold in build_tokens.py (4.5 vs 7 for text).

$sources: (opt) Where the style came from: figma | screenshot | description | codebase. Cited in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.
notes: Brand requires primary on white for all CTAs; no gradients.
